provenance.source: Wuwa Personal Assistant v1.0.19 weak-baseline quality screening
provenance.notes: Project screening heuristic, not official or mathematically optimal investment advice. Preserve bounded +15 exploration before three tuned slots. At +15 or later, when both the selected baseline and current candidate score are below the profile usable threshold, require sufficient full-level probability of reaching that threshold in addition to target-relative improvement probability and expected positive gain. The usable probability uses the same future-cost and supply-adjusted threshold; passing/perfect labels and qualified flags do not affect replacement spending. Expected final score need not itself reach the quality floor. Only future checkpoint EXP and new tuners are charged; past investment is excluded.
